assertion: An event exists, described as "Migrant deaths at border".
judge_quote: At least 57 migrants trying to reach the Spanish territory of Ceuta have died after breaching the border from Morocco, as tens of thousands of people entered the enclave in the past 24 hours.
evidence_cited: At least 57 migrants trying to reach the Spanish territory of Ceuta have died after breaching the border from Morocco, as tens of thousands of people entered the enclave in the past 24 hours.
The Spanish government confirmed the raised death toll on Friday evening.
Earlier in the day, Juan Jesus Vivas, the regional president of the North African Spanish enclave, had told reporters that 34 people had perished, without giving details about how they died.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Mass crossing into Ceuta".
judge_quote: He said about 60,000 people had crossed from Morocco into Ceuta by land and sea, many by swimming around a border barrier stretching into the water.
evidence_cited: He said about 60,000 people had crossed from Morocco into Ceuta by land and sea, many by swimming around a border barrier stretching into the water.
Video footage on Thursday showed hoards of people, mainly Moroccans, walking around the breakwaters onto local roads.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Sanchez visits Ceuta".

evidence_cited: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez, who travelled to Ceuta on Friday, said his government was mobilising all available resources in response to the situation.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Repatriation of migrants".

Spain’s Ministry of Interior said some 25,000 people were returned from Ceuta to Morocco so far on Friday.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Humanitarian crisis in Ceuta".

assertion: An event exists, described as "Clashes at border".

assertion: An event exists, described as "EU reaction to crisis".

assertion: An event exists, described as "France tightens border".
